label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Focus on Benefits, Not Just Features
body: Show your audience how your product or service improves their life or solves a problem, rather than simply listing what it does.
caption:
When you talk about your work, it's easy to get excited about all the cool things it can do. But for your audience, what really matters is how it helps *them*. Frame your descriptions around the positive outcomes or solutions your offering provides. This helps people see the value right away. Think about what pain point you solve or what desire you fulfill.
